I isolated the red diagonal ladder on the right side - bottom just right of the PIRAT board, top high on the front mast below the basket.

I excluded the thick white anchoring bar at the bottom and the converging point/knot at the top. Then enlarging the ladder area I traced the center line from bottom to top and tallied each red horizontal rope crossing it, in groups of 5 to avoid losing place, then re-checked top-down.

Bottom white bar - excluded
1-5 just above white up to hull rail,
6-10 up past deckhouse,
11-15 up to about cannon/spotlight level,
16-20 up through mid-rigging,
21-24 getting very short up to just below the apex,
apex knot - excluded.

That gives 24 red steps in between.
COUNT: 24

The ladder is the reddish diagonal shroud on the near side,
bottom fastened just right of the PIRAT board, top meeting
the fore-mast below the basket.

I started just above the thick white horizontal anchoring bar
and did not count it, then followed the two converging side
ropes up-left toward the mast, ticking off every red
horizontal intersecting rope. I grouped them in 5s going up
to keep track and double-checked against the sky background.
I stopped before the final converging point-knot at the top
and did not count that knot.

Bottom 5 clear, then 5, then 5, then 5, then 6 very close
together near the top = 26 red steps in between.
COUNT: 26

I identified the correct ladder as the steep red-sided rope ladder that starts just to the right of the PIRAT board in front of the stern deckhouse and runs up-left to the foremast below the crow's-nest.

I excluded the thick white horizontal bar at the very bottom and excluded the converging point/knot at the very top. Then I traced the two diagonal side ropes from bottom to top and counted every red horizontal rope connecting them in order, checking in small groups of 5 to avoid losing place, lower section against the hull, middle against the deckhouse, upper against the sky.

I get 35 red steps in between.

COUNT: 35

I found the diagonal red-runged shroud on the right side, running from the deck just right of the PIRAT board up-left to the fore-mast below the crow's nest.

I excluded the white horizontal bar at the very bottom and the converging point/knot at the very top. Then I traced the two side ropes from bottom to top and counted each distinct red horizontal rope between them in order, 1-by-1 from the wide bottom rungs to the very short top rungs, and checked again top-down.

That gives 28 red steps in between.
COUNT: 28

I identified the diagonal red-sided ladder on the right side of the image.

Its foot is the white bar low on the right, just to the right of the PIRAT board, and it runs up-left to the fore-mast below the crow's-nest basket.

I excluded the bottom white anchoring bar and excluded the converging point/knot at the very top.

Starting with the first red horizontal just above the white bar, I followed the two side ropes upward and tallied every red horizontal cross-rope in order, in groups of 5 to avoid losing place, then checked back down from the top.

That gives only the red intermediate steps between the white bar and the top knot.
